issue.title: test_bob_dry_run_canonical_report_has_no_digest_suffix fails: bob highlights create now requires -P/--parent

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails deterministically in isolation and at pre-epic base 70c51adbdd: 'bob highlights create --include-id --dry-run --bob-dir ... x.md' exits 2 with 'bob ref create: error: --parent is required' (hint: pass -P <note>). bob-cli made highlights create an alias of ref create with a required --parent; the test helper _bob_dry_run never passes one. Also check whether the research-highlights file-hook command in the sase-research-artifacts plugin needs the same flag.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the sase-1j6 land agent's check triage on master 05bab368af; the failure reproduces at the pre-epic base, so it is not caused by sase-1j6.
